answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must stake cryptographic collateral where registration incurs a superlinear cost scaling as O(N^2), burning tokens upon entry. Slashing conditions destroy value like melting copper in a furnace. Every identity must deposit an unrecoverable stake, while network rewards bloom like a lotus only for persistent nodes. A malicious cluster submitting pseudo-identities faces exponential capital drain, turning mass forgery into an unviable economic sonnet of self-destruction.
